text:
DevOnCall Bot: [ALERT] Elevated 5xx and gateway timeouts observed for service=redwood-serving in us-east-1
ops-bot: paging on-call: @maria
Customer Success Bot: Notified customers with active sessions in impacted region: list attached

Maria Chen: I'm awake, seeing spikes in 5xx and 504. Dashboard shows request queue depth at 98% for gpu-pool-7. Starting triage. :eyes:

Kevin Patel: I can jump in if you want. Any indications it's infra vs model?

Maria Chen: Initial telemetry: CPU fine, GPUs at high-util, batching engine backlog growing. Looks like batch assembly is slower than usual -> queue clogging -> front-of-queue requests timing out. Rolling up runbook: https://confluence/redwood/runbooks/queue-clog

Ashley Rivera: Observed error surfacing at the gateway level — gateway returning 502 for long-poll requests.

Devin Lopez: Are we seeing KV cache thrashing? That can blow up latency for seq-length edge cases.

Maria Chen: Good call. Dumping scheduler stats to help. Past 3m snapshot:
```
batching_engine.backlog = 12400
avg_batch_assemble_ms = 420
gpu_utilization = 94%
avg_inference_ms = 180
timeouts_per_min = 320
```

Maria Chen: That avg_batch_assemble_ms jumped from 90 -> 420 after a burst of 50k reqs. Suspect a bursty traffic profile created lots of tiny priority batches and starved the assembly loop.

Kevin Patel: Can we flip to emergency-throttle policy on gateway to shed small/low-priority requests? `curl -X POST https://ops-api/route/throttle -d '{"route":"/v1/generation","policy":"egress-shed"}'`

Maria Chen: Applying throttle now. `ops apply throttle route=/v1/generation policy=egress-shed` -> got 202

ops-bot: throttle policy applied to /v1/generation :white_check_mark:

Ashley Rivera: After throttle, queue depth down to 46% and 5xx rate trending down. Timeouts still present but decreasing.

Maria Chen: Creating temporary bypass route to route high-priority traffic to dedicated pool (dedicated-pool-2). Creating canary: `route add --path /v1/generation?prio=high --target dedicated-pool-2 --canary 10%`

DevOnCall Bot: Canaries enabled, traffic directed: 10% -> dedicated-pool-2

Devin Lopez: Dedicated pool handling spikes fine. We should consider increasing batch assembly workers or increasing max-batch-wait for small requests to avoid tiny-batch overload.

Kevin Patel: For immediate relief, propose aborting stale batches older than 600ms to avoid front-of-queue locking. Maria, can you change `batcher.max_wait_ms` to 600?

Maria Chen: Updating config: `cfg set batcher.max_wait_ms=600` -> applied on gpu-pool-7

ops-bot: config change rolled to gpu-pool-7 :rocket:

Maria Chen: Post-change metrics: avg_batch_assemble_ms -> 150, backlog -> 2.5k, 5xx down 85% from peak. Customers with impacted sessions: 14 enterprise tenants flagged, CS informed.

Customer Success Bot: Escalation emails queued to impacted customers; triage doc: https://docs.redwood/incident-2154321000

Kevin Patel: Plan for next 24h: monitor, revert throttle gradually, schedule follow-up to tune batcher concurrency. Create postmortem once stable.

Ashley Rivera: Noting that model quantization change earlier today may have increased per-token latency for certain models; include model infra in postmortem.

Maria Chen: Oncall handing to Kevin for next hour for stabilization. I'm off to run deeper traces. @kevin take it.

Kevin Patel: Taking over. Thanks Maria. Will keep the channel updated. :thumbsup:

Maria Chen: Closing pager. If anything spikes, re-ping with `!pager`.

DevOnCall Bot: Pager closed by Maria Chen at 2154321365
